Name: Optimistic Sebastian
Author: WG333
Description:
[size=3]This is exclusively a dialogue mod. No additional portraits, events, or items have been added. I have not tweaked any questions asked by Sebastian, or any of his heart events.

[/size]How to test if this mod is working:
Create a new profile, and talk to Sebastian. His normal introduction is:
"Oh. You just moved in, right? Cool. Out of all the places you could live, you chose Pelican Town?"
With the mod, his introduction is:
"Oh. You just moved in, right? Cool. I'll see you around then."

If you encounter any bugs while using this mod, or would like to request any new features, please contact me! You can leave a post on the mods page, or message me on Nexus. Alternatively, feel free to ping me in the official Stardew Valley discord, at WG#3752.
